notes.title: Christmas Quest & State Of The Game
notes.content:
Hello Hello!

How are you all doing? Apologies for being away for quite a while, I'm currently preparing the game for its final release and with it, a few changes are being made to make sure the code is clean and the features are solid.

Quite a massive amount of changes were made on this one, here's a summary of the big ones:

[list]
[*]The game has been upgraded to use Unreal Engine 5
[*]Better compatibility with Linux using Proton (Tested using Linux Mint)
[*]Shop now sells different items depending on their locations
[*]New items and weapons
[*]Item physics updated to be more gameplay friendly
[*]Weapons now have attributes such as Damage, Attack Speed among others
[*]New compass UI to help navigation
[*]You can now revive your team members by interacting with them (No longer needs to head back to a flag)
[*]Lighthouse Cave lighting improvements
[*]Frogs and Notes achievements can now be completed by collecting all currently available ones (No longer need to wait for Full Release to get those)
[*]New loading screen
[*]Performance optimizations
[*]Various under the hood code improvements and refactors
[/list]

[b]And of course, the Christmas Quest is back![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/1bcf93ab17509d08db186fe54d13daaeb59c7a26.jpg[/img]

Now by the nature of the above changes, I gotta be honest with you, there's probably new bugs that I now have to fix because of it. I tried my best to make those changes as smooth as possible. If you do see anything and would like to help please feel free to post them on the Community Hub.

Lastly, because I'm getting it almost ready for full release, you may also see from a distance the upcoming levels far away, this is because there's some assets being shared between Early Access and the Full Release version. 

[h1]Unreal Engine 5 & Linux/Proton[/h1]

As the game is getting closer to its final release, I realized that now is the time for a final engine update. There's a few features from the newer engine that I started to use but those will mostly be seen on the final levels of the game.

I've noticed on previous versions of the game that on Linux using Proton the videos were not working at all. However the rest of the game worked fine so that made me decide to strip away pre-rendered videos from the game, hence why a new loading screen (and also startup visuals). That should help Linux users have a better experience!

[h1]Shop, Items and Weapons[/h1]

New items and weapons are being created for the game, and It only made sense to have custom vendors per location to better accommodate the change. Those items may have different attributes and the game will show you the difference between your equipped one and the ones you're looking for.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/8f8de11b24c2367dd43790c5777787172756cdc1.png[/img]

The physics were also updated because It felt a bit frustrating at times where items would just fall or slide across and you would essentially lose them. So they now use a simpler physics that makes them essentially not move around and only listen to gravity.

[h1]Compass[/h1]

This might be a partially just for fun feature but I kinda do think it's nice to indicate where you should go, especially after the second quest where it pretty much becomes a massively open world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/9139aea0c4c5c5b6137e9102a742ebc84283aee2.png[/img]

It will show you the available quest map locations and undiscovered quests if there's no current quest.

[h1]Reviving Team Members[/h1]

A bit of a frustrating thing I've noticed with previous versions is that every time Jonathan, Almika or Sarsi dies you have to manually go back to a nearby flag to revive them. I honestly didn't know how annoying this was until I implemented this new feature; all you have to do is get near them and smash your interact button and they'll be back up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/fdc6e28997b50acb4a3707262e0c3919a25f07c9.gif[/img]

The only catch is that if you're in a fight you might not be able to smash interact enough to save them otherwise enemies will start attacking you, so be safe!

[h1]Lighthouse Cave Improvements[/h1]

Here are some screenshots of the new Lighthouse Cave lighting:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/1318bcd3582104dde3c2850522f4826864af5e1c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/fc037e4142fc3c60d4fd934a601ed839a73a46a3.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/260a534e255d02986b03142ced6e1c4c9f1d1b38.jpg[/img]

[h1]That's all for now![/h1]

I'm sorry for taking a bit longer again on the full release but I really hope the amount of effort being put into this makes it worth the wait.

Please feel free to share your thoughts on the update or even the full release delays, I'm always keen on having an open discussion on these things, your support means the world to me.

Merry Christmas!
Lucas

notes.title: General Improvements Update
notes.content:
Hello Hello! It's me again, this time with another update for War Islands. This one focuses on quality of life and general improvements for the game. Here's the list of changes:

[list]
[*] Lighthouse & Wookikota level changes
[*] New item pickup HUD notification
[*] New selected character HUD health bar
[*] Items now glow for easy visibility when they're on the ground
[*] Coin bags now give random number of coins
[*] Sarsi's boulders now get destroyed on dash hit
[*] Sarsi combat mode duration tweaked
[*] Sarsi AI improvements during Reerion's battle
[*] Icicle hit location indicator visuals updated
[*] Fixed Possess indicator showing on non controllable animals
[*] Fixed crash when carrying Little Timmy too far away from quest area
[*] Fixed mount animation glitching when mounting deleted character
[*] Saturday Island snail button no longer closes gate if Snail move away from it (Avoids sea turtle being locked inside)
[*] Fixed being stuck using cannon when swapping characters
[*] Fixed crash when moving animals too far from their original location using Almika's possess
[*] Ships network lag improvements
[*] Shop now sells the original boomerang weapon
[*] Shop items price updated
[/list]

[b]So there's some major visual changes to digest here, let's talk about some of them![/b]

[h1]Item Glow, Pickup UI and Coins Amount[/h1]

A good example of how one thing leads to another. I wanted to increase the amount of coins you get with every coin bag that enemies and crates drop. The game was literally giving you 1 (one) coin per bag which made it extremely difficult to afford shop items. From now on the game will randomize a few coins every drop.

Now after implementing this I realized that you need some sort of feedback of how many coins you're getting so for that I've created a new pickup pop up that shows on the HUD. This should tell you how many coins you got and for consistency sake it also shows any other item you collect there too!

Another thing I began to notice is sometimes those coin bags are hidden on the grass or bushes, so I also added a new glowing effect to all items so you never miss them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/c0da1036dbcb8830c32d092d3bc9533e8c950461.gif[/img]

[h1]New Health Bar For Selected Character[/h1]

Sometimes we forget about the most obvious things, this one is no exception. Your selected character (the one you're controlling) now shows their health bar at the bottom of the screen during combat or when losing health in general. Once health amount restores to 100% it fades to still maintain a clean HUD design.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/930940fef27620dc1d6e95b71be11b1e4dea98c0.gif[/img]

[h1]Icicle Hit Location Visuals Updated[/h1]

This one specifically I haven't heard anyone talk about, it's mostly me thinking that's not really obvious where the icicle will hit. This should help beat the Crystal Cave quest!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/94e9a4fc1739653626ad863f480d760dcb433fff.gif[/img]

[h1]Sarsi's Dash Now Break Boulders[/h1]

Boulders in general were most of the time just blocking your way after being pushed so there's no point in keeping them rolling. From now on they will break after being used.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/830d66f4b0deef221980601220bee2b03e75892a.gif[/img]

Anyways, that's all for now :)

Cheers,
Lucas

notes.title: Feedback Update: New Features & Improvements
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Today I'm happy to announce that War Islands just got a brand new update ready for you. This time it's more of a major feedback update, [b]I've read the reviews and the comments on the Community Hub and decided to gather it all for a single large update[/b]. Here's the key new features:
[list]
[*]Jonathan now has a sword!
[*]Almika now uses the Boomerang and Staff (Boomerang is no longer a Jonathan weapon)
[*]New skills for Jonathan, Sarsi and Almika
[*]New Character UI Screen
[*]New Melee Combat Lock On mode
[*]Skill Points are now given when you complete main quests
[*]New Intro tutorial puzzle
[*]New keys added for custom keyboard binding
[*]Puzzle helper signs can now be disabled in the settings menu
[*]New Bullseye textures for explosive targets
[*]Crosshair now becomes red when aiming enemies
[*]Mount system to help easily jump in/out of sea turtles and other animals
[*]Split Screen Keyboard & Controller mode
[*]Main characters can now swim!
[*]Sharks are now actual NPCs!
[*]Main characters clothing/hair physics added
[*]Various game bugs fixed
[/list]
So for this post I would like to do a breakdown of the reasons why I've decided to make these changes and how I think they really benefit the game!

[h1]Main Characters Redesign[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/e8982a7fcf97094e811b80e66342ec060fe21079.jpg[/img]
One of the things that always bothered me a little bit is how the characters were originally designed, when I first created them, I don't think I did a good job of making sure they felt good. Also stuff such as having a boomerang melee attack never really made much sense.

As of today, Jonathan now has a sword and no longer uses the boomerang, the boomerang has been moved to Almika so she can do two range attacks. [b]The weapons are now actual items in the game and you already start with a crossbow and sword for Jonathan, staff and boomerang for Almika and lastly claws and armor for Sarsi.[/b]

The importance of having those as actual items is because I've refactor the way the game deals damage by now getting the damage from the weapon itself, [b]meaning in the future I'm planning on adding weapons that deals more damage.[/b]

This leads us to the next topic,

[h1]New Melee Combat Lock On Mode[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/8be3d5839556848f8f87b9cb3d70b97edae5786c.gif[/img]
[i]"The controls feel loose"[/i]

It took me a while to figure out this one since it's not an easy thing to change. I eventually realized that all melee attacks in general were really difficult to do. Seriously on previous versions of the game attacking with your boomerang was hard since you most of the time would miss your attacks.

[b]Now the game has a brand new combat system that makes your character lock on enemies so you can strafe sideways and dash without worrying about facing the right way[/b]. Brand new animations were added to make this happen!

For ranged attacks, some such as the boomerang also got some love, in fact, [b]the boomerang was completely redesigned as well and it's more of a quick auto aim attack for Almika[/b]. The boomerang can be used on certain skills as well but those are now made more for a support role.

[h1]Swimming & Sharks![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/81d9c8eae50f8031e7f8c0d7ff06dfd964f21ca4.gif[/img]
[i]"I managed to slip off the pier and into the water like 5 times in a row because the whole movement is so jerky. Did I mention this means instadeath?"[/i]

I personally think the movement in the game is relatively good, happy to further improve it but I did realize that it makes absolutely no sense to just touch the water and get insta killed by a shark. [b]So that's why sharks are now npcs that see and chase you[/b]. With that in mind I decided to go a bit further and straight up [b]add swimming mode to all main characters[/b].

For now there isn't much in terms of what you can do underwater though, maybe in the future this can be expanded. Happy to hear more feedback on this!

[h1]Mount System[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/1419669e22ebd1e940663f6d52d8f6042b258153.gif[/img]
[i]"movement is clunky."[/i]

I couldn't figure out exactly what is clunky but a few things were really bad for sure, one of them is how there was basically no way to mount a sea turtle, essentially you just had to jump at the right time and location. [b]Now that's also fixed, when you jump to a turtle the game snaps you to her shell meaning you no longer randomly fall or miss it[/b].

[h1]New Keys for Custom Keyboard Binding[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/6984c4b882ea9ec801a63627b1c9d46682e5c84b.png[/img]
[i]"The controls are not freely configurable (try the number block, right ctrl key or the keys above the arrow keys)."[/i]

I would like to apologize for that one, I never really thought about adding all possible keys available for keybinding in the game, [b]so this also got some love; you now can use most of your keyboard and mouse buttons.[/b] (I believe I covered all supported by the game engine)

[h1]Split Screen Keyboard & Controller Mode[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/0fbe7a705250f6cd37d9933354a29786719d71f9.png[/img]
[i]"is the one player on keyboard and one on joystick feature still unavailable?"[/i]

Not anymore! You can now play War Islands having only one controller for your friend. [b]So you play using Keyboard & Mouse and your friend a controller.[/b] Heavy improvements to how the game detects controllers as well, you can pick how many and which controllers to use!

[h1]Christmas Special Quest[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/1bcf93ab17509d08db186fe54d13daaeb59c7a26.jpg[/img]
Lastly, the Christmas quest is back! This time the tree is sitting outside, get ready for some action fighting the evil snowmans!

[h1]In Conclusion[/h1]
This is my first time making a post going into details exactly what each individual review and comment has to say about the game and trying to improve that. I hope I got your feedback right as I'm trying my best to ensure the game feels great.

There's a few more improvements I would like to do but couldn't be ready for the Christmas season so I had to postpone.

I genuinely hope you like these changes! <3
Lucas

notes.title: The Battle Of Nine Lives Update: Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/80775d0d36c05e59afa0c084985fba3d3361a7d1.jpg[/img]
Hey everyone! I'm happy to announce that [b]The Battle Of Nine Lives Update is out now[/b]! Call your friends and return to War Islands on this brand new update! Lots of new quests, items and puzzles to beat!

[h3]Key Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*]New Main Quest! [b]Meet Me Halfway[/b]: Continue the story of Jonathan, Almika and Sarsi by going to the Honey Cave in order to find a cure for Sarsi, [b]fight the cats and meet Nekomata (the cat's leader)[/b]

[previewyoutube=eyYV_iFJiZ8;full][/previewyoutube]
If you already have a save game from past updates, don't worry, you can use it to continue playing the storyline just fine. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/9b502ca3d075396dae9e70f4e41e012e5f870b2d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/b28910b8c5affaaf6433e83428e9f52ea70363dd.jpg[/img]

Lucas

notes.title: Let's Talk #12 - Underwater Improvements, Levels and More!
notes.content:
Have you ever wonder what it would be like to swim in War Islands? Today I would like to talk about a very interesting thing I’ve accidentally discovered while testing new features for the game: The ability to swim! (Yes, really).

I was actually just testing upgrades for the Sea Turtle when I got a bit frustrated by falling in the water every time, so I quite literally did a small test, the movement felt solid, added a short swim animation and with a bit of polishment I’m sure it’ll look great.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/686532c693f336ecd22745bbd572109ce0bc40e9.jpg[/img]

So that lead me down a rabbit hole of making sure the game looks good underwater, began by making a new underwater screen effect so you can see more clearly, then some lighting tweaks and finally added missing details to some lakes and rivers throughout the game.

Now I’m thinking on changing how shark attacks work entirely, potentially making them an actual npc in the game, reason being is because I noticed that sometimes it’s a bit annoying to instantly get killed by a shark without no time to quickly get out of the water.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/6b80a723345c07f5b344e5e2382670471c40af55.jpg[/img]

All in all I’m definitely keen on adding that feature to my to do list. I’ll try to push it alongside the new level update but can’t guarantee since I’m aware that I’m taking way too long to release the next level. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/009143d51cf9ab6002e84c3283c47a9049b142a1.gif[/img]

Another cool little thing we did was improving Jonathan’s crossbow, the texture was a bit off so we now have a fancy new one for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/31d339991f988136b708627f17f39056e3ff9171.jpg[/img]

Finally, we are also expanding our team so we already began development of future levels to avoid long delays between updates. The props above for example are for a new jungle level, I know I’ve been really silent lately but there’s really a lot of new content coming up for the game!

So, what are your thoughts on swimming in the game? Let’s talk!

Lucas

notes.title: Let's Talk #11 - Upcoming Features, Dev Challenges and More
notes.content:
Long time, no see! I know It’s been quite a while since my last post but It’s been really tricky to manage time lately, I’ve got quite a lot of stuff in the works for War Islands.

Lately I’ve been working on some heavy changes to the Save System, one of the issues I was having is due to the amount of items increasing the game couldn’t load all items info at once (Due to how It was previously developed) so now the game only load item data on demand. How’s is that related to the Save System you might ask? Well, the game’s savedata was previously saving items based on their hard reference path and so forcing the game to always load all items (even if you’re not using them).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/0ab8afc4f43aeab83e544ccd529c5863bd3f6e4b.jpg[/img]

The new update will feature a brand new character panel that now shows all items your character currently has equipped. This is useful since we added weapons to the game and thus planning on possible adding stats bonus for them. (damage, health and other bonuses)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/07ce594c66ce06de7e25ed549916ac0a9425fead.jpg[/img]

In previous posts I did mention the two new upcoming areas, Honey Cave and Morumotto Forest. For Morumotto the only thing left to do is a few tweaks and voice acting. Honey Cave however still needs some work such as some puzzle design, characters and it’s cinematic event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/7ec00e86ff5072ab6982392509c1ee9f08fed88a.jpg[/img]

Alongside all of that, lots of performance optimizations were done under the hood for the whole game. From things that I mistakenly left calculating without need in the background to overall noticeable visual effect differences.

I’ll return with more frequently posts sharing our development status soon, I can’t wait to get this update out for you all!

Lucas

notes.title: Game Engine Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I'm pushing a new update that might seem a bit large but that's because I've decided to update the game engine to provide more overall stability to the game, here are the few things you can expect from this update:

- Game engine updated
- Fixed split screen players wardrobe, map and other menus not closing when any cinematic starts
- Characters can now equip items on the fly without needing to go to a wardrobe
- Pickup items now swap to what's currently equipped when picking up
- Fixed rare occasions where after dying in a boss fight, game reloads elsewhere
- Christmas content disabled

If any of you experience issues with this update please let me know!

Have a great week!
Lucas

notes.title: Let's Talk #10 - Save The Christmas Tree!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, Lucas here! Today we’re pushing our Christmas special quest back online! This time with a new item for you. The peppermint stick!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/1bcf93ab17509d08db186fe54d13daaeb59c7a26.jpg[/img]

I’ve been looking to get weapon items in the game for quite a while now, decided to give it a try on this Christmas quest. Beat the initial 5 waves and get the item permanently on your save game, the quest is replayable meaning, you can play more than 5 waves to beat me on the leaderboard if you’d like. :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/7845eec48e9ac2edffa3a4a6e7feca4c9d57b6f9.jpg[/img]

This update also includes a new rain effect and some overall game improvements, lately I’m focusing on Morumotto forest which is a upcoming completely new area featuring 2 new side quests. One of the key features of Morumotto will be a brand new Jonathan weapon: The Harpoon Gun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/2d3ad38cfe2accd5d2b98bac3ed6f3b877a1fa7b.jpg[/img]

I’ll be sharing more details on Morumotto soon, just need to get a few more things done. In the meantime feel free to enjoy some nice snow in War Islands!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/c96507b766259e78ea2c5b784b6ff1a1c91c19dd.jpg[/img]

So what do you think? Like the new Almika’s Peppermint Stick item? Let’s talk! :)

Lucas

notes.title: Let's Talk #09 - Halloween Puzzle is back!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Today we’re pushing a update to re-enable the Halloween puzzle. It’s your change to get a nice Halloween pumpkin!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/41eed46e62c870d56a2fc116c325fe4365e98bfd.jpg[/img]

Last year you visit it by talking to a Dabiriu near shore, this time in order to visit it you need to go by the interior part of the Fort! A brand new space for you to explore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/692227199a8df7f6bcfea4a29b10c599cb4c2435.jpg[/img]

From there you talk to this nice fella, the one with a pumpkin on his head! Beat the puzzle and get your pumpkin! Hope you like it! Just make sure you got the skills needed to complete the puzzle!

notes.title: Let's Talk #08 - What's next? Honey Cave and Morumotto Island
notes.content:
Hello everyone, Lucas here! I know it’s been a while since our last post. We got quite busy in the past few months. We’re now working on the next levels: Honey Cave and Morumotto Island.

I think we’re finally gonna be able to explain why the name “War Islands” since we’re gonna introduce our main villain, the cats:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/8db2fd7643ca07a1a52bb12fa80b5407c9ffaeb3.jpg[/img]

You probably heard Dabirius (the guinea pigs) talk about them a few times during the game. That’s right , they’re at war with the cats for a very long time. Initially we actually thought of putting the cats in the beginning of the game but that would make them quite a easy enemy to defeat.

The next main quest will be located at the Honey Cave, this level will be more focused on the story itself since quite a few people reached out giving feedback about the lore itself. The map is still in it’s early stages but we’re already developing the bee character.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/3e31ff7f30350871fb38f21db031c81ae21085c1.jpg[/img]

Now since the next main quest will be storyline focused, we decided to also develop a second extra island called Morumotto Island. A completely different biome with new side quests and puzzles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/f52d6a3bf4c88b821c6935f1c26cacd4d86caf4b.png[/img]

So far we have a few areas of the Morumotto island created although there’s still some in design phase. Also the soundtrack is already being worked on as well. We will be talking more about it soon!

As for our latest update, Wookikota Forest. I noticed a few things that we could definitely improve and we will tackle those eventually down the line, right now we wanna push as much content as possible. 

Feel free to give your feedback about it! Let’s Talk! :)

Lucas

notes.title: Wookikota Minor Fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I just pushed a update to fix a few things in the game:

- Tutorial section improved: It now teaches the player to switch characters
- Rare Crash related to game AI navigation fixed
- During Wookikota Forest, there's now a wood sign to hint players to use Almika mounting on Sarsi
- Fixed Windmill area ladybug not lifting off when reloading the game
- Fixed Almika possess skill getting stuck when target is too far away from original location
- Fixed Soundtrack not playing on clients when reloading during boss battles

If you find anything, let us know!

Cheers,
Lucas

notes.title: Wookikota Forest Update Now Available!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Lucas here. Today we’re happy to announce that our Wookikota Forest update is now available for download. Get the latest update from Steam and boot up the game!

[previewyoutube=Xh6J_oxEm20;full][/previewyoutube]

This update drastically changes the game, starting with the fact that the game is now a open world game. A few weeks ago I mentioned in our latest “Let’s Talk” (#07) how we actually started trying some open world tests just for fun. Which ended up being way too cool to not implement it. That decision took me months to basically re-write a lot of code, split levels and adapt the game in general to this new style. Not to mention how the whole team had to do new content to fit in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/e83bca1aa28fbc4fe54aa7d38c1da3d85825b9de.gif[/img]

One thing ended up leading to another. I started noticing that the game needed more stuff to do in the environment so for that we decided to create a coin system so you can gather coins from crates, barrels and also enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/5f9f8f2f257b57daeabc4256434478a837c8d964.gif[/img]

So you can use your Sea turtle to visit new islands to get not only coins but also items, frogs, etc. After finishing the second quest you’re free to go to any place you’d like (There’s still however a invisible wall to areas that are not yet developed).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/f96ca16ae2d542ca5cb420530ceb4473dd759301.gif[/img]

We also added more skill tokens in the Lighthouse Cave and some in Wookikota to give more cool mechanics right away since we heavily refined combat over the past few months.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/8e769a0aac5c2756035366b19bac27993923e80e.png[/img]

That and a lot more is already available in the latest update, we genuinely hope you have a great time playing it! Let us know if anything pops up; cool ideas, feedback, bugs etc. Thank you so much for the support! :)

Lucas, Lead Developer.

notes.title: Let's Talk #07 - Open World, Coins and your own SeaTurtle!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, Lucas here! I know it’s been a while since our last post but we genuinely believe this one is worth the wait. Last month I’ve been playing the game with the team and we decided to “just for fun” try a open-world style gameplay, initially very buggy but enough for seeing if it was worth the shot. Turns out it’s extremely cool to “just go” to places without any loading screens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/9f2f1df99fec72be151e8176bff22a399d69088f.gif[/img]

However that was no easy task, converting the whole game to a open-world style is quite challenging. Basically everything broke and some stuff had to be heavily re-designed to fit this new style. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/b5bb11ffcb767bb8dae91dcd2382ded0cdd23a53.gif[/img]

A few days ago I was finally able to get it properly implemented and tested. We really can’t wait to release this next update. We’re not only getting the next main quest done (“A New Hope”) which will feature a whole new area called Wookikota Forest. but also the open-world system including the ability for the player to get coins from enemies/crates, and the best of all: Your own SeaTurtle that allows you to go anywhere you like.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/86b02b3d18fa29b12378d727ef4397d83c40ecc1.gif[/img]

So to provide a great initial experience controlling the SeaTurtle we decided to add more islands to the game with extra content. We’re really focus on getting much more content ready for you soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/a1396abdb454a43e6a4981079d5dd21e8d74dd7a.jpg[/img]

The game will also no longer lock time of day (except for specific quests) meaning it’s fully dynamic, so we decided to develop a rain/weather system to randomly kick in from time to time. (I’m still tweaking the percentage of rain)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/c0627666ca05f8334f2b7aa97ad947a4e3f56dc3.gif[/img]

So, do you like what’s coming up? Let’s Talk! :)

Lucas, Lead Developer

notes.title: Let's Talk #06 - New Side Quest: Luke's New Pet
notes.content:
It’s time to jump back in and play our latest quest “Luke’s New Pet”, help Luke protect his new baby spider. This quest rewards you with a Flashlight hat and features a global leaderboard since it has infinite waves of enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/f15f54aaf4d21cd2391f7ee2622542d3b250bf21.png[/img]

Quests now show more information on the game menu. This one specifically shows that it’s replayable and contains rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/afe8218db817cc1b9f1a61b8a2cdeca0ba66b3a2.png[/img]

Since it’s a quest that relies on combat. After hearing your feedback we greatly improved combat on certain areas. Most noticeable the recoil and impact. Also dead npcs don’t highlight their bodies anymore helping you focus on the ones chasing you instead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/201ad32b46a5b23b4fd34eb23d375f1d387d5ec1.gif[/img]

To further improve gameplay experience, objects that allows interaction now highlights when you hover your mouse over to avoid miss clicking. Not only that, we also improved controls on Dragonflies to help decelerate faster. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/294cbbc30387f69257f4d8fc767f5414023decdc.gif[/img]

This update also improves the game menu with new map markers that provides much more information of your progress including markers of collected frogs and notes, wardrobes, undiscovered quests and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/421ff5526d6ce6e71efaec0311c6a7c4d04c67e4.png[/img]

The wardrobe menu also got some visual improvements!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/092f852ffbb9105b076ea29859271d47ff00d8de.gif[/img]

A lot of improvements have been made to the game in the past month and we really hope you have a great time playing War Islands! 

So, what do you think about this update?

Let’s talk!

notes.title: Let's Talk #05 - Christmas Special
notes.content:
Hello everyone! First of all apologies for posting this announcement a bit late. Today we just pushed a update featuring a Christmas special quest where you have to protect the Christmas tree from angry snowmans.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/e945df720525bb8d3ee656c7d4b771b6dd9f36b1.jpg[/img]

Your goal is simple: Beat Wave 5 to win a in-game permanent Christmas Hat! You’ll have 3 Dabirius (guinea-pigs) to help you during the fight. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/782ffa21cc1c8de2f9ad5baecf60fa84fd59c752.jpg[/img]

The game now shows health bars of your buddies to make sure you keep track of how injured they are. So if they’re less than full health a bar will pop over their head.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/923d5d10f095712089bf2fe6a2bf2b5dd2759666.jpg[/img]

So what are you waiting for? Get to the base and talk to this little fella to get the quest started!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/8e879c13c28286af74e196bd71e82d4632df73ec.jpg[/img]

Don’t forget to tell us how many waves you managed to beat, Let’s talk!

notes.title: Let's Talk #04 - Discord server, Wookikota development and more
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We would like to officially announce our community Discord server. We’ve been using Discord for a little while but only as a internal team chat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/dcbc1430f698c297e5f41ac124e1bd101aa6476b.jpg[/img]

So if you’re looking for a place to find new people or just wanna have a nice chat with our team, jump in. You’re more than welcome there!

[url=https://discord.gg/TpSeTW5a4B]War Islands Discord Community Server[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/a48d1f7069fc5de437b969e4a48422b9a0144a8c.jpg[/img]

As for our next level development, the Wookikota Forest. We’ve been trying our best to finish it this month but unfortunately it’s not yet completed. We think it needs a bit more time in the oven as we don’t want to just rush things out. We’re deeply sorry for the delay but we really think you’re gonna love what’s coming up next.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/bcadcad0b11cbe4a8718b02e414c72e83aaa065c.jpg[/img]

We also have pushed a update yesterday that has significant improvements to Multiplayer sessions. A lot of network optimizations have been implemented for War Islands alongside new options in the Settings menu such as Mouse Sensitivity, Gamepad Axis, Brightness and more!

Keen to hear from you all over on Discord. Let’s Talk!

notes.title: Let's Talk #03 - Halloween & Items!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It’s Halloween season! To celebrate we created a brand new quest that comes with a reward, a special Pumpkin Helmet item that will be yours to keep. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/4a74f174b746c3615cc81084b21e3bb50ddba494.jpg[/img]

In order to start the quest, make sure you have the Dash and Rope Bridge skills active. You can find a Skill Token for Sarsi in the Lighthouse island.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/f8a80f3d77834bba6feb65576b0bbef70babf686.jpg[/img]

You can now customize your characters by going to any wardrobe. Every item you collect can be equipped!

Make sure to re-visit the Lighthouse Cave since we put a few items there as well! :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/4cf6f893fdf4946f64c03008f12078fd883f467f.jpg[/img]

Not only that but we also added the ability to choose save slots. So you can have multiple save slots. Currently the third slot is the one used in Multiplayer sessions with your friends. 

Also, thanks to your feedback we improved the Lighthouse Cave even further by tweaking Araknya’s (boss) hitbox and improving the fireplace arrow mechanic.

We hope you liked these new changes as we’re working hard to keep developing new content to the game.

That’s all for now, feel free to comment what do you think about these changes. Let’s talk! ;)

notes.title: Let's Talk #02 - Coming Up for November
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We would like to share what we’ve been doing behind the scenes for the next upcoming level, the Wookikota forest!

A lot of major bug fixes have been already included in our latest update (Today) to make sure the game gets more polished for your next experience.

We’re planning to release the next update by the end of November. So stay tuned for that!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/3c803ec43ae2e7f2c084322936dc5eaedf89d120.jpg[/img]

Our team is working on not only the level itself but the new enemies that our heroes will encounter. They include Werewolves during the night and also carnivorous plants!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/20a6fc3d2631a5281e2c4a607f0181b7f6d785a5.jpg[/img]

The next level features a more open environment that will include both day and night events. The screenshot above is showing a WIP of the new puzzles; both mechanics and overall design. (Though not all assets are finished just yet)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/10576fd0ccf5d44f33c359eebf861718991f5d56.jpg[/img]

We also got a concept art for the forest’s Werewolf boss. He’s your next big enemy. We haven’t started the modelling and animation phase for him just yet but shouldn’t take long. Right now we’re starting on the carnivorous plant model.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/219112bff8293b13cce6173ab58a327d9e44b0bc.jpg[/img]

The plants will have a unique set of movement to make sure they get a new combat experience. Our goal is to give players new methods of defeating enemies such as environment objects not only as puzzle solving elements but also combat support.

That’s about it for now, feel free to comment what do you think about the next level. New ideas are always welcome! Let’s talk! ;)

notes.title: Let's Talk #01 - New Tutorial!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We pushed a new update to War Islands that makes the initial part of the game easier due to player feedback. There’s now a tutorial section to help new players to get around the main base.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/5856da9817ac274c892079205361ee9ca1017b1b.jpg[/img]

Some players mentioned that it wasn't so easy to understand how the skill tokens work when you first jump in. So we added this tiny sequence that starts as soon as the initial dialogue finishes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/19a6c8df7c5cab03c3617668b3cdef9cec3d32a1.jpg[/img]

We decided to also do some small tweaks to the Game Menu. Some quests now show hints on the map + if the player has available skill points to spend, a tiny notification will show in the Skills tab button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/cb3660cb490ba856e8810f89e10c7b189b74a4bc.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450577/9b8812c614a118a51cd58ba54821802d3d139761.jpg[/img]

We genuinely encourage you all to keep sending feedback. We’re more than happy to implement new features!

So what are your thoughts about these changes? Let's talk!

Hope you have a great week :)
